description: C2 (S4), proposed for web task T44: the camera as the relay receives it, four optional keys (and two more from C3, S5: inputWithheldSpans, inputQueueOverruns) for relay-job.v1's $defs.heartbeat.properties, written in that def's style (each anyOf a value or null; absent until known, never sent as 0 for unknown). The compositor sends them only when RELAY_INPUT_BEAT=1: web's heartbeat is strict (additionalProperties: false, zod .strict()), so the flag stays off until web's contract declares these keys. T44 adds these six entries to docs/contracts/relay-job.v1.json verbatim (descriptions may be reworded); the compositor then re-vendors (scripts/vendor-contracts.sh) and crates/adapters/tests/contract.rs checks the vendored entries' types against this file's. This file is not part of contracts/ (never hand-edited, AGENTS.md section 8).

inputGiveUpReason.description: Why the compositor gave up the camera generation inputGiveUpGen (moved it from connecting or running into backoff): connect_timeout (no first decoded frame within the connect timeout), stalled (running with no frame for the stall window, or a stall the pipeline reported), phone_live_discard (web's phone-live counter rose while the connect had carried no byte: one discard an outage), hold_end (Cloudflare's hold-end close on a connect), eos (the camera stream ended), error (a pipeline error). Sent with inputGiveUpGen; omitted until a generation is given up. The last one stays on every later beat until another replaces it.

inputGiveUpGen.description: The camera generation (its pipeline build number, 1 the first) that inputGiveUpReason is about. Sent with inputGiveUpReason; a rise between beats is a new give-up.

inputReceivedFps.description: Camera frames per second as the relay received them: decoded camera frames written into the programme's camera slot over the beat window, to one decimal. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero (the camera sent nothing the window long). A beat that comes within 2.5 s (the rate's minimum window, OUTPUT_FPS_MIN_WINDOW_MS) of the last reading repeats that reading and keeps the window open: so the edge beat that announces a programme phase change can carry the previous window's camera rates, not the camera at the change.

inputReceivedKbps.description: Camera bitrate as the relay received it, kbit/s, rounded: the bytes out of the SRT source, every build's, decoded or not, over the beat window. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero. A beat that comes within 2.5 s (the rate's minimum window, OUTPUT_FPS_MIN_WINDOW_MS) of the last reading repeats that reading and keeps the window open: so the edge beat that announces a programme phase change can carry the previous window's camera rates, not the camera at the change.

inputWithheldSpans.description: C3 (S5): spans in which compressed camera video kept entering the relay's decoder and no picture came out for at least 500 ms (the programme's freeze, frozen_after_ms): the decoder withholding pictures to the next keyframe after a lost reference. A total for the relay process that only grows; a span is counted when its picture returns. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0 for unknown: a present 0 is a measured zero.

inputQueueOverruns.description: C3 (S5): the times the queue before the relay's camera decoder (4 s of compressed video, CAMERA_VIDEO_QUEUE_MS) was full and blocked the camera's source; it drops nothing. A total for the relay process that only grows. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0 for unknown: a present 0 is a measured zero.
